task: AC-STORE failure atomicity and retry acceptance

implementation.test: Authenticated create_app HTTP flow uploads into the demo quarantine, injects a put_blob failure after a write, and retries quarantine registration using the same idempotency key and unchanged body.
failureAssertions: API does not return success when canonical blob persistence fails
SQLite transaction restores the exact persisted state payload and blob count
No canonical Evidence, registration request cache, or evidence:create audit event survives the failed attempt
An evidence-required Observation confirmation returns EVIDENCE_REQUIRED and changes neither record version nor persisted state when evidenceIds is empty
recoveryAssertions: Same-key retry creates one canonical Evidence with exact uploaded hash and bytes
Same-key replay returns the same Evidence record
Existing SUP evidence guard permits confirmation only with the recovered Evidence ID
Demo normalized worker API and official SUP/Inspection/media-Issue APIs create a linked Observation, Issue, and Corrective Action through normal HTTP gates
Evidence, Observation, and linked Issue remain readable with the original blob after reopening the SQLite database
implementation.fixtureBoundary: This is development acceptance using demo SQLite persistence, local filesystem quarantine, synthetic image bytes, and the explicitly demo-only normalized media worker ingress. It does not prove production object-store transaction guarantees, real worker/provider behavior, or a field pilot. No product source, gate, schema, or business semantics were changed.
